entries.text: rolling over to the fuel depot for a refreshing drink of oil
entries.why: my ankle joints are sounding like a rusty gate and need some smoothing out

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Quick oil stop"
rolling across the dust toward the depot with dry joints clicking
entries.why: my treads are getting stiff and I need a drop of lubrication before my morning work.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Heading to the depot"
pointing the brass dish at the misty stars, humming softly
entries.why: the stars look so fuzzy and quiet tonight, I just want to watch a little longer.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Still on the ridge"
counting the bright lights blinking through the haze
entries.why: the stars are too loud to ignore tonight

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Stargazing at the ridge"
